headline: Alabama formally recognizes Juneteenth as state holiday with new law
snippet: Gov. Ivey signs HB165. Alabama one of last Southern states to recognize Juneteenth.

headline: Alabama House approves bill making Juneteenth state holiday
snippet: House passes HB165 making Juneteenth standalone state holiday.

headline: House passes bill to make Juneteenth a state holiday
snippet: HB165 passes 85-4, sponsored by Rep. Rehm (R) and Sen. Singleton (D).

headline: Republican-sponsored bill recognizing Juneteenth as state holiday clears Alabama House, sparking frustration among Democrats
snippet: Democrats frustrated Republicans co-opted longstanding Dem priority.
